people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.
translations.bsb: In that day men will look to their Maker and turn their eyes to the Holy One of Israel.
translations.kjv: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
translations.asv: In that day shall men look unto their Maker, and their eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
